• Payroll: Oversee and finalize monthly payroll processing for clients.
• Reconciliations: Conduct reconciliations for GST and TDS.
• Accounting Standards: Apply strong knowledge of Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) and Corporate Taxation.
• Transfer Pricing Audit & Documentation

Qualifications & Skills:
• CA Firm Experience: 2+ years (Mandatory).
• Education/Expertise: Strong foundation in Accounting, Auditing, Taxation, and Compliance.
• Technical Skills: Proficiency in Tally, Advanced Excel, and accounting software.
• Knowledge: Strong understanding of taxation laws, GST, TDS, PT, Ind AS, and corporate taxation.
• Soft Skills: Analytical mindset, detail-oriented, strong communication, and organizational ability.
• Preference: Local candidates; in-person interviews preferred.
• Fluent in English with good communication skills
• Punctual, professional, and responsible

Ways to Stand Out:
• Display genuine interest in accounting, taxation, and compliance.
• Be proactive and take ownership of assignments.
• Show strong client handling and deadline management skills.
• Maintain professionalism, discipline, and team spirit.
• Demonstrate eagerness to learn and adapt to complex assignments.
• Come prepared for technical and practical interview questions

Next Step:

If you are an experienced accountant looking to accelerate your career with real-world exposure, diverse assignments, and professional mentorship, we would love to hear from you. Please share your resume on hr@registrationarena.com

Job Description: Senior Accountant / Assistant Manager Finance (D2C, Quick Commerce, Airlines, Defense)

Location: Pune, India

Department: Finance & Accounts

Experience: 4–8 Years (CA / Semi-CA or Post-Graduate in Finance)

Industry Preference: D2C, FMCG, Beverage & Food Manufacturing

About the Role

We are seeking a sharp, detail-oriented Senior Accountant / CA to manage our core financial operations during a phase of rapid expansion.
Unlike traditional retail, our brand scales across high-velocity Quick Commerce platforms (Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart) and high-volume Institutional Accounts (Airlines, Defense, Key Accounts). You will be responsible for complex reconciliation cycles, margin analyses, GST/compliance, and working capital optimization across these specialized channels.

If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, love structured ledgers, and can navigate channel-specific deductions and inventory audits, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities

1. Quick Commerce & Institutional Reconciliation

• Q-Commerce Sales Reconciliation: Execute daily/weekly settlements and automated reconciliations for Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, and Amazon.

• Deduction & Credit Note Audit: Track, verify, and reconcile platform deductions, promotional allowances, listing fees, damaged stock returns, and platform commission invoices.

• Airline & Key Account Billing: Manage high-volume institutional invoicing for airline partners (In-Flight Catering & Branding), ensuring precise PO-to-invoice matching and timely payment collection.

2. Inventory Accounting & COGS Management

• Monitor raw material (cocoa, coffee beans, packaging materials) and finished goods inventory across central warehouses, dark stores, and third-party logistics (3PL) nodes.

• Track Cost of Goods Sold (COGS), yield variances, and wastage during manufacturing and packaging.

• Conduct periodic physical inventory audits and reconcile physical stock with Tally/ERP records.

3. Taxation, Statutory Compliance & Audits

• Direct end-to-end GST compliance: filing GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, matching 2B reconciliations, and managing e-way bills for interstate inventory transfers.

• Ensure accurate computation and timely deposit of TDS/TCS and monthly statutory dues.

• Coordinate with internal and external auditors for statutory financial audits, tax audits, and year-end closures.

4. Cash Flow & Management Reporting (MIS)

• Prepare weekly channel-wise revenue, gross margin, and contribution margin (CM1/CM2) dashboards for leadership.

• Manage vendor payouts, airline trade credit cycles, and working capital forecasting.

• Maintain meticulous books of accounts up to finalization of Balance Sheets and P&L statements.

Who You Are (Qualifications & Skills)

• Education: Chartered Accountant (CA) or Inter-CA / M.Com with 3–5 years of strong post-qualification experience in D2C, FMCG, or retail distribution.

• Channel Expertise: Direct experience managing accounting for quick commerce aggregators (Blinkit, Zepto) or major institutional B2B/airline clients is highly desirable.

• Tech Stack: Advanced proficiency in Tally Prime / Zoho Books / SAP / ERP systems and expert-level MS Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, Power Query, automated reconciliation sheets).

• Compliance & Tax: Deep understanding of GST regulations, HSN code classifications, e-invoicing norms, and TDS/TCS mechanics.

• Mindset: Numbers-obsessed, proactive, and capable of holding channel managers accountable for credit terms and settlements.

Why Join Us?

• High-Growth Exposure: Own the finance seat for high-traction, modern distribution channels shaping the future of retail.

• Direct Leadership Access: Work closely with the founders and leadership team to optimize margins and cash cycles.

• Ownership: High autonomy to set up robust reconciliation systems and automated financial workflows.

About the role

This role sits within an emerging independent strategic advisory practice focused on promoter-led businesses. The practice works at the intersection of ownership, control, capital readiness, governance, leadership transitions, enterprise continuity, and global integration.

The role is intended for someone who is intellectually curious, highly structured, discreet, and capable of turning complex ideas, documents, and conversations into useful analytical outputs. It is suitable for candidates from CA, CS, LLB, MBA, commerce, or adjacent backgrounds who want to work close to high-quality strategic thinking rather than in a purely routine execution role.

Role purpose

The Analyst – Strategic Advisory will support the development of the practice's intellectual frameworks, diagnostic tools, client materials, and engagement delivery processes.

The role involves helping translate broad promoter concerns into structured research, sharp briefing notes, client-ready documents, internal knowledge files, and well-organised delivery support. It is not a routine administrative role. It is intended for someone who wants to build depth in ownership, governance, capital, promoter-led business, and cross-border institutional issues.

Key responsibilities

1. Research and knowledge building

· Build and maintain research files on ownership, control, capital architecture, governance, succession, next-generation transitions, and cross-border structures.

· Track relevant developments, frameworks, and case examples relating to promoter-led businesses, family enterprises, investor rights, governance design, and institutionalisation.

· Convert reading and source material into concise notes, issue summaries, and practical insights.

2. Framework and content development

· Support the refinement of internal advisory frameworks, including diagnostic reviews, scoring models, question banks, and pillar-wise working tools.

· Help prepare one-pagers, briefing notes, point-of-view documents, website content inputs, and discussion decks.

· Turn conceptual thinking into structured charts, tables, presentations, and written materials.

3. Client engagement support

· Prepare client background notes, promoter group summaries, entity maps, and meeting briefs.

· Organise and analyse documents shared by clients, such as ownership charts, agreements, governance materials, structural notes, or family-business documentation.

· Attend selected internal or client discussions to capture structured notes, key themes, risks, and follow-up items.

· Prepare first drafts of diagnostic summaries, issue notes, and working papers for review.

4. Delivery process and internal organisation

· Build and maintain internal templates, trackers, checklists, and document libraries.

· Help institutionalise the practice's internal workflows for research, client preparation, and output generation.

· Ensure confidentiality, version control, and orderly management of sensitive materials.

Ideal candidate profile

The ideal candidate is likely to come from one of the following backgrounds:

· CA / CA finalist / articleship experience with strong interest in governance and strategy.

· Company Secretary (CS) / CS trainee / qualified CS with interest in ownership and governance matters.

· LLB / legal research background with interest in corporate structures, governance, and promoter-led business issues.

· Early-career MBA / commerce / economics candidate with strong research, writing, and analytical capability, especially if exposed to consulting, legal, tax, or transaction-oriented work.

Experience range

· 0 to 3 years of relevant experience.

· Freshers with exceptional analytical ability, writing quality, and seriousness of intent may also be considered.

Skills required

· Strong written English with the ability to summarise clearly and think in structured form.

· Excellent analytical and research ability.

· Strong proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel, Word, and document structuring.

· Ability to read complex material carefully and extract what matters.

· High discretion and comfort working with confidential information.

· Maturity, reliability, and willingness to learn in a high-trust, high-ownership environment.

What will matter most

· Intellectual seriousness.

· Structured thinking.

· Writing quality.

· Discretion.

· Ability to work on ambiguous, high-consequence topics without needing rigid instructions at every step.

· Genuine interest in promoter-led businesses, ownership, governance, capital events, and enduring institutions.

What the role is not

· Not a routine execution role.

· Not a transaction execution role in the conventional investment banking sense.

· Not a mass legal drafting role.

Pune, India.

Full-time preferred. A high-quality part-time or apprenticeship-style arrangement may also be considered in the initial stage for the right candidate.

Indicative compensation

Indicative compensation may range from approximately INR 3 lakh to INR 4.5 lakh per annum, depending on profile, prior exposure, and demonstrated capability.

This role offers the opportunity to work closely on the creation of a distinctive strategic advisory practice in the areas of ownership, governance, capital readiness, and institutional transitions.
